description: Call one capability by id at its listed price. Available referral credit is applied automatically first. payment_path x402 needs agent_key; balance needs agent_key or api_key; upstream needs agent_key, parent_call_id, and composition_token, is charged to the parent supplier, and is one level only. A 402 challenge is returned as data. Unpaid x402 reservations expire after one hour; retry with a new idempotency_key.

api_key.description: Optional alternative to agent_key for balance calls.

composition_token.description: Required for upstream; supplied to the parent capability endpoint for this dispatch.

idempotent_replay.description: Set true only for an explicit same-call-id replay after an uncertain upstream dispatch.

name: capability_call
title: Call an explicitly selected capability
